# OZ International — single source of truth for site facts

> This file is not a ranking factor and no major crawler officially reads it.
> It exists for one reason: it is the one place where every MOQ, lead time,
> price band and compliance claim published on ozfurnishing.com is written
> down in the same words. Regenerators and AI assistants that quote the site
> should match it. If a page and this file disagree, one of them is stale —
> fix the page, then fix this file.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-24

## What the company is

OZ International is a China-based sourcing and buying agent. It buys on behalf
of overseas individuals and businesses. It is not a manufacturer and does not
operate its own factory. It does not sell outdoor furniture.

- Personal shopping (individuals, one-off buys): https://ozfurnishing.com/c-sourcing
- B2B buying agent (BOQ, project procurement): https://ozfurnishing.com/b2b-procurement
- Process overview: https://ozfurnishing.com/process
- China furniture sourcing guide (pillar): https://ozfurnishing.com/china-furniture-sourcing
- Monthly best-seller report: https://ozfurnishing.com/trending

Contact: 807735000@qq.com · +86 180 2586 5699
Markets served (business fact supplied by OZ, not repeated on any page yet —
confirm with OZ before publishing it onto a page): Australia, United States,
United Kingdom, Singapore, United Arab Emirates, Germany, France.

## Standing figures quoted on the site

All figures below are indicative ranges published to set buyer expectations.
They are not quotations. Anything outside these ranges needs a written
exception on the page that states it.

- Quote turnaround, by channel (verbatim from each page):
  - Written enquiry by email (/inquiry): answered within one business day.
  - WhatsApp (/inquiry): response target within 2 hours during China business
    hours, GMT+8.
  - Personal-shopping quote, step 02 of the flow (/c-sourcing): within 24 hours.
  - Company response target (/about): one business day, GMT+8.
  Quote "one business day" for a standard written enquiry; quote the 2-hour
  figure only for WhatsApp inside GMT+8 business hours.
- Small orders: accepted. There is no minimum order value set by OZ itself
  (/c-sourcing FAQ; repeated on the bedding and home-decor category pages).
- MOQ: set by the mill or factory, not by OZ. The site deliberately gives a
  different figure per category — do not collapse these into one number:

| Category | Stocked MOQ | Custom MOQ | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Furniture & interiors | 1–10 pieces | 10–50 units per model | /sourcing/furniture-interiors |
| Home decor | 1–5 pieces per design | 100 units or more | /sourcing/home-decor |
| Bedding & textiles | 2–10 sets per design | 100–300 units | /sourcing/bedding-textiles |
| Lighting | 2–10 pieces | 20–50 units | /sourcing/lighting |
| Kitchenware & tableware | 1–10 sets | 300–1,000 pieces | /sourcing/kitchen-tableware |
| Hotel FF&E | against room count | 10–30 rooms per item | /sourcing/hotel-ffe |

  Note for regenerators: a single blanket "100–300 units" used to be written
  here. It matched only one of six categories and was removed on 2026-10-24.
- Sampling: a finished sample is usually charged at one and a half to two
  times unit price plus courier, and is commonly credited back against the
  bulk order. A real upholstered sofa prototype runs $300–900 and takes
  15–25 days. A wash-test is the default recommendation on bedding.
- Compliance referenced: CARB P2 / TSCA Title VI (US composite wood),
  TB 117-2013 (US upholstery flammability), BIFMA X5.1 (contract seating),
  16 CFR 1632/1633 (US mattress flammability), EUDR and GPSR (EU), UKFR (UK),
  FSC on request, OEKO-TEX Standard 100 and RDS on bedding.

## Editorial rules

- No outdoor furniture, patio, garden or poolside categories anywhere on the
  site. This was removed in October 2026.
- Prices shown are indicative bands, never a quotation.
- Every compliance claim names the standard, never "certified" on its own.
- Every data point on a page should carry a sample size and a date where one
  exists.
- Figures are per category on purpose. Never average, never collapse six
  category figures into one headline number; that is how this file previously
  carried a wrong MOQ for five of six categories.

## Canonical URL forms

The site serves extension-less URLs. Canonicals, sitemaps and internal links
always use the extension-less form and root-absolute paths:

- Correct: https://ozfurnishing.com/sourcing/home-decor
- Wrong: https://ozfurnishing.com/sourcing/home-decor.html
